summary: Ero Copper Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing positive exploration drilling results at its Furnas Copper-Gold Project in Brazil. The release details assay results from 24,000 meters of drilling, highlighting high-grade step-out and infill intercepts that extend known mineralization. The filing is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No transaction, corporate action, or strategic change is disclosed.
